# Formino

> MIT-licensed TypeScript dynamic form engine for React and Ant Design. Supports schema-driven forms, low-code applications, and AI-assisted form development.

Repository: https://github.com/eugeneaiao-ui/formino
Package name: forminojs
Install: npm install forminojs
Release: 0.1.0
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/forminojs
Core has no React or Ant Design imports. UI adapters support edit, preview, snapshot, validation, dependent fields, async options, and custom controls.

## Start here

- [English overview](https://eugeneaiao-ui.github.io/formino/README.en.md): capabilities, installation, minimal example.
- [Chinese overview](https://eugeneaiao-ui.github.io/formino/README.md): documentation index.
- [AI and low-code integration](https://eugeneaiao-ui.github.io/formino/docs/AI_INTEGRATION.md): JSON generation, validation, renderer, limitations.
- [Configuration JSON Schema](https://eugeneaiao-ui.github.io/formino/schemas/form-definition.schema.json): version 1 serializable configuration subset, not a schema for submitted values.
- [JSON example](https://eugeneaiao-ui.github.io/formino/examples/ai/service-request.json): runnable service request form.

## Long forms and dependencies

- [Illustrated examples](https://eugeneaiao-ui.github.io/formino/docs/EXAMPLES.md): 100/300/1000-field demo, asynchronous cascade, multi-stage calculations, dynamic attributes, conditional validation, snapshots.
- [Measured browser performance](https://eugeneaiao-ui.github.io/formino/docs/PERFORMANCE.md): production-build measurements, environment, raw samples and reproducible scripts.
- Progressive mounting renders batches but retains the complete DOM afterwards. Full-form validation must wait until every field is registered.

## Reference

- [Configuration](https://eugeneaiao-ui.github.io/formino/docs/CONFIGURATION.md): template, fields, middleware, data sources and dependencies.
- [API](https://eugeneaiao-ui.github.io/formino/docs/API.md): exported interfaces.
- [Recipes](https://eugeneaiao-ui.github.io/formino/docs/RECIPES.md): common application patterns.
- [Quick start](https://eugeneaiao-ui.github.io/formino/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md): complete typechecked example.
- [Example JSON adapter](https://eugeneaiao-ui.github.io/formino/examples/ai/parse-definition.ts): Ajv validation plus field/source checks; example code, not a package export.

## Integration boundaries

- The JSON contract covers built-in controls and serializable properties only. It does not execute JavaScript, import components, or accept arbitrary API URLs.
- Host-approved data-source names may be referenced; application code owns network access and authorization.
- Advanced calculations, custom controls and renderers use the TypeScript API, registered by the host.
- The library is a form engine, not a complete visual drag-and-drop builder, LLM service, or general-purpose JSON Schema form renderer.
- llms.txt is a documentation index, not a search-indexing or AI-recommendation guarantee.
